title: 第23章 战前准备第24章 观众与演员
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
接下来的日子里，苏醒每天都使用一次【如影随形】，和自己来一次5分钟的生死搏杀，从一开始的赤手空拳，到铁棍，到手持没有开锋的练习剑，再到开锋的铁剑，影子越来越强，苏醒也越来越强。
苏醒的战斗天赋被激发，他和罗璇轩每天的对练，开始显现成果，每天都在进步，这让罗璇轩赞叹不已。
从一开始对他的怀疑，到认可，最后到坚定不移的认为，这个叫苏醒的家伙，未来必定前程远大。
两人的武器也从训练剑变成了真正的杀器，一开始，罗璇轩还能控制节奏，保证自己和苏醒不受伤。
但是随着时间的过去，苏醒开始受伤，因为罗璇轩已经不能把控全局了，无法做到收放如心。
从苏醒开始受伤的那一天开始，训练房里又多了一个人，一个叫费定福的三阶白银治疗师，他会在苏醒受伤的时候，发动技能给苏醒疗伤。
就好像苏醒和影子搏斗后，自己偷偷的用【岐黄符】给自己疗伤一样，这个治疗师也会某种技能，快速的治疗苏醒的伤口。
但是这个治疗师基本上就是个工具人，每次和罗璇轩一起来，也一起走，看上去有点傲气，就好像苏醒欠了他钱一样。
苏醒的整个人的气质也发生了转变，变得锐利又沉稳。
慢慢的，苏醒又不再受伤了，因为罗璇轩光靠招式已经很难对他造成伤害，这个治疗师也就跟着消失了。
直到这一天，和罗璇轩对练完成后，他开口道：“好了，明天我就不来了，还有5天，比赛就开始了，你自己沉淀一下吧，我没有什么要教你的了。”
“说真的，你的进步速度超乎我的想象，你的战斗直觉在缓慢又坚定的增长，要不是你身上没有来自生死厮杀的血腥味，我还以为你每天都在和人生死搏杀呢。”
罗璇轩长叹一口气，说道：“看来大哥的眼光就是比我准，小子，你的未来将远超过我。”
他拍了拍苏醒的肩膀，认可的点了一下头，苏醒再次行了一个启点镇最高规格的谢礼，罗璇轩转身，挥了挥手，提步离开。
不管罗家兄弟最终打的什么主意，苏醒还是记得这三个月发生的事情，记住这段时光，至少罗璇轩的教导，对他的帮助是巨大的，这一刻，苏醒才真的觉得自己在这个世界有了安身立命的资格。
接下来的5天，苏醒并没有松懈，还是像往常一样，上午练习《百炼钢体诀》，和影子来一场生死搏斗，下午修习《狂风剑法》，晚上练习符士技能。
他没有用符去刷技能种子的等级，因为他觉得现在练好本源技更加重要，《狂风剑法》提高了他的剑术技巧，让他知道什么时候进攻，什么时候防守。
《百炼钢体诀》全面提高了他的身体素质，按照他自己测量后的结果，大概提高了2倍的身体素质。
如果对比职业技能里的【白银锻体法】的数据显示，他认为自己起码提高了100点的体质，60点的力量，30点的精神，远超职业体系带给自己的提升。
如果用【文昌符】来刷职业技能，也许他能得到更高的数值点数，但是能得到罗璇轩的亲传，不是什么时候都有这个机会的。

《百炼钢体诀》和《狂风剑法》带来的是还有对自身力量的深层发掘和控制，苏醒现在挥出一剑，可以把力度控制在1公斤到8000公斤间的任意数值里。
收发于心，这才是最大的收获。
比赛前的最后一天，苏醒给自己放了个假，出去和大地神官赵凯喝了一顿酒，他喜欢听这个开朗的大男孩吹牛。
晚上，苏醒盘腿坐在自己的房间里，脑海中观看着职业种子：
【职业：单手剑士白银位格】
【基础剑术】-11级-动量增加44%
【挥砍】-13级-动量增加92%
【白银锻体法】-12级-体质+24-力量+12-精神+12
【职业：天机符士幻想位格首位特权】
【制符术】-12级-符箓效能+12%
【控符术】-34级-符箓叠加+34张
content_en:
In the following days, Su Xing used [Shadow Follower] once a day, and had a 5-minute life-or-death fight with himself. From the beginning with bare hands, to an iron rod, to a practice sword without an open edge, and then to an open iron sword, the shadow became stronger and stronger, and so did Su Xing.
Su Xing's fighting talent was stimulated, and the results of his daily sparring with Luo Xuanxuan began to show results, with progress being made every day, which made Luo Xuanxuan marvel.
From doubts about him at the beginning, to recognition, and finally to the unswerving belief that this guy named Su Xing will definitely have a bright future in the future.
The weapons of the two of them have also changed from training swords to real killing weapons. At the beginning, Luo Xuanxuan was able to control the rhythm to ensure that he and Su Xing were not injured.
But as time went by, Su Xing began to get hurt, because Luo Xuanxuan could no longer control the overall situation and could not control everything.
From the day Su Xing started to get injured, there was one more person in the training room, a third-level silver healer named Fei Dingfu. He would activate skills to heal Su Xing when he was injured.
Just like after Su Xing fought with the shadow, he secretly used the [Qihuang Talisman] to heal himself, this therapist also has a certain skill to quickly heal Su Xing's wounds.
But this therapist is basically a tool. Every time he comes and goes with Luo Xuanxuan, he looks a little arrogant, as if Su Xing owes him money.
Su Xing's whole temperament also changed, becoming sharp and calm.
Slowly, Su Xing was no longer injured, because it was difficult for Luo Xuanxuan to cause damage to him with just his moves, and the healer also disappeared.
Until this day, after finishing the sparring with Luo Xuanxuan, he said: "Okay, I won't come tomorrow. There are still 5 days before the competition starts. You can calm down on your own. I have nothing to teach you."
"To be honest, your progress is faster than I imagined. Your combat intuition is growing slowly but surely. If you didn't have the smell of blood from life and death fighting on your body, I would have thought you were fighting life and death every day."
Luo Xuanxuan let out a long sigh and said, "It seems that my elder brother's vision is more accurate than mine. Boy, your future will be far better than mine."
He patted Su Xing's shoulder and nodded in approval. Su Xing once again gave the highest level of thanks in Qidian Town. Luo Xuanxuan turned around, waved and left.
No matter what the Luo brothers finally decided, Su Xing still remembered what happened in the past three months. Remembering this period, at least Luo Xuanxuan's teachings were of great help to him. At this moment, Su Xing really felt that he was qualified to settle down in this world.
In the next five days, Su Xing did not relax. As usual, he practiced the "Hundred-Refined Steel Body Technique" in the morning, had a life-and-death struggle with the shadow, practiced the "Gust Sword Technique" in the afternoon, and practiced Talisman skills in the evening.
He did not use talismans to level up his skill seeds because he felt it was more important to practice his original skills well now. "Gust Sword Technique" improved his swordsmanship skills and allowed him to know when to attack and when to defend.
"Hundred-Refined Steel Body Technique" has comprehensively improved his physical fitness. According to his own measurement results, his physical fitness has increased by about 2 times.
If compared with the data of the [Silver Body Forging Method] in the professional skills, he believed that he had improved his physique by at least 100 points, his strength by 60 points, and his spirit by 30 points, far exceeding the improvement brought by the professional system.
If he uses [Wenchang Talisman] to brush up professional skills, he may be able to get higher numerical points, but it is not always possible to get Luo Xuanxuan's personal inheritance.
"Hundred Steel Body Techniques" and "Gust Wind Sword Technique" bring about in-depth exploration and control of one's own power. Su Xing now wields a sword and can control the strength anywhere between 1 kilogram to 8000 kilograms.in the numerical value.
Sending and receiving from the heart is the greatest gain.
On the last day before the competition, Su Xing gave himself a holiday and went out to have a drink with the earth priest Zhao Kai. He liked to listen to this cheerful boy bragging.
At night, Su Xing sat cross-legged in his room, watching the career seeds in his mind:
[Occupation: One-handed Swordsman Silver Rank]
[Basic Swordsmanship]-Level 11-Momentum increased by 44%
[Slash]-Level 13-Momentum increased by 92%
[Silver Body Forging Method]-Level 12-Physique +24-Strength +12-Spirit +12
[Occupation: The first privilege of the fantasy character of Tianji Talisman]
【talisman making】-Level 12-talisman effectiveness +12%
[Character Control Technique]-level 34-talisman stack +34 pieces
